containers.name: probe
args:
#!/bin/sh
set -u
ENV="stage"
echo "===I2822A_R2_START env=$ENV host=$(hostname) utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
apk add --no-cache curl >/tmp/apk.log 2>&1; echo "apk_rc=$?"
doc(){
  t=$1; lab=$2; p=$3
  B=/tmp/d.$$
  code=$(curl -s -m 30 -o "$B" -w '%{http_code}|%{size_download}|%{content_type}' "http://$t$p" 2>/dev/null); rc=$?
  echo "DOC [$lab] $p rc=$rc -> $code"
  echo "-----BEGIN_BODY $lab $p-----"
  head -c 150000 "$B" 2>/dev/null
  echo ""
  echo "-----END_BODY $lab $p-----"
  rm -f "$B"
}
probe(){
  t=$1; lab=$2; shift 2
  for p in "$@"; do
    B=/tmp/b.$$
    code=$(curl -s -m 8 -o "$B" -w '%{http_code}|%{size_download}|%{content_type}' "http://$t$p" 2>/dev/null); rc=$?
    echo "HIT [$lab] $p rc=$rc -> $code :: $(head -c 300 "$B" 2>/dev/null | tr '\r\n' ' ')"
    rm -f "$B"
  done
}
probe 'lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-data-133727252ebfb39b.elb.us-west-2.amazonaws.com' stage-elb-data '/dms/data-dashboard' '/dms/my-filters'
doc 'lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-data-133727252ebfb39b.elb.us-west-2.amazonaws.com' stage-elb-data /swagger/api-docs
probe 'data-management-service.data-management.svc.cluster.local' stage-svc-data '/dms/data-dashboard' '/dms/my-filters'
doc 'data-management-service.data-management.svc.cluster.local' stage-svc-data /swagger/api-docs
doc 'lazamedical-stage01-usw2-notif-d77570bc840c8449.elb.us-west-2.amazonaws.com' stage-elb-notif /swagger/api-docs
doc 'lazamedical-stage01-usw2-auth-1f669cd8e505558a.elb.us-west-2.amazonaws.com' stage-elb-auth /swagger/api-docs
doc 'lazamedical-stage01-usw2-authz-f4d3f83adff11424.elb.us-west-2.amazonaws.com' stage-elb-authz /swagger/api-docs
doc 'lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-s3-69b73411fecfb483.elb.us-west-2.amazonaws.com' stage-elb-s3 /openapi.json
doc 'lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-meta-bb718a5f6a114d83.elb.us-west-2.amazonaws.com' stage-elb-meta /openapi.json
doc 'lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-deid-01b675cdf44c4c3b.elb.us-west-2.amazonaws.com' stage-elb-deid /openapi.json
doc 'user-management-service.user-management-service.svc.cluster.local' stage-svc-user /swagger/api-docs
echo "===I2822A_R2_DONE env=$ENV utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
